about_the_game:
This DLC is about the transfer of famous beautiful female characters and female generals during the reign of Emperor Wu of the Western Han Dynasty

Martial Generals Growth All XXXXX

Yu Ji's transfer prop Yu Meiren Sword melee

1. [Goddess Deterrence] has an additional 20% restraint damage on all types of troops

2. [Goddess System] Goddess system, all five dimensions are calculated according to the highest term

3. Vampire attack 30% 4 Random state attack 5. Restore state every round

Chen Ajiao's job transfer prop, Xiaowu Chen Empress Sword melee

1. Double click counterattack 2. [Resolve] deals an additional 100 fixed damage 3. Snake and Scorpion attacks come with poisoning effects

4. [Martial Arts 3] When counterattacking, an additional 35% damage is added. 5 Mobile+2

Liu Ling's transfer prop is the Huai'an Demon Queen Taoist flute

1. [Resentment] Learn to use full screen skills to explode. 2 Restore status every round

3. [Beauty] Spirit Shield 50% 4. [Poison Gas Adaptation] The body is surrounded by poison gas, which increases one's own abilities by 15%

5. [Poison Strategy] When attacked, counterattack with poisonous smoke.

Princess Pingyang's transfer prop, Princess Yangxin Chang's step bow

1. Infinite attack twice Force Shield 30% 3 Add spell explosion flame

4. [Divine Arrow Shooting Sun] Penetration Effect X-shaped. 5. [Continuous Slash] Double Blade Continuous Slash. When launching an attack after moving, double clicking is necessary

Wei Zifu transferred to a new position and thought about props

1. [Mental Arithmetic] Save 25% mana consumption. 2 Nine grid unfriendly units add 15% spirit. 3. [Invisibility] Will not be actively attacked by the enemy

4. [Medical skills] Learn a lot of treatment and auxiliary strategies. 5 Learn the Great Return Blood Spell: White Tiger

Lady Gouyi's transfer prop, Master Jieyu's scepter

1. 25% Force Shield 2 【 Immortal Body 】 Increases spell critical damage by 20%. 3 Spiritual strength+25%

4. Spell must hit 5 When using the strategy, deal an additional 50% damage to the designated target

Mrs. Li's transfer to a prop dancer, melee martial arts, and style double swords

1. Attack adds 3% real damage. 2 【 No Top 3 】 Before attacking, every move increases the damage by 5%

3. Move+3 4 【 Gale 3 】 Gale attack deals higher damage to units with lower mobility, with a damage bonus of 4 * (14- target movement)%.

5. [Continuous Slash] Double Blade Continuous Slash: When launching an attack after moving, double clicking is necessary

Queen Moon melee fan

1. [Tiger Descending the Mountain Waist] Reduce damage to its own life limit by 40%

2. [Entanglement] Adjacent enemy moves consume 2

3. 120% adaptability to all terrains

4. [Leveling] Moving on any terrain is like walking on flat ground, consuming only 1 movement force

5. [Life Attack 10%]

Zhuo Wenjun, Master Wen Hou, Qin

1. Spell combo 100% 2 Spell ignores terrain 3 Spells ignore the weather

4. Music Restrictions [Controlling the Mind] 5 Spell pursuit, Qin music pursuit

Yihua Changyu melee whip

1. First hand attack 2 Breakthrough Attack 100% 3 Da Wuyu's attack range

4. Fighting with 2 people. 5 Attack with accompanying poisoning effect

Note: If you have purchased but have not received this DLC, please enter the "Start Game" interface of Steam Hanwu Emperor Chronicles. There is a "Manage My DLC" button at the bottom right corner of the interface. Remove all other hooks that only keep this DLC and content add-on DLC to enter the game and receive it. After receiving it, check other DLCs. Only one operation is needed, and once successful, all archives will be permanently valid.

Can't operate or contact if there are any problems 392788593@qq.com , can remotely assist with operations

The gift package was originally worth 3000 RMB and is now being sold with broken bones. There are no further discount promotions available.

Customer service email: 392788593@qq.com Official QQ group: 985109086 (there are strategies and exchanges with experienced chess players in the group)
